A node may be internally valid while resting on an unverified_legacy object — node 2 and node 5 both do.

reasoning_chain.name: Extraordinary sacrifice/expense intentionally and reasonably made for common safety (Rule A)
Losses allowed: direct consequence of GA act (Rule C); excluded: delay consequences (Rule C)

Fault: rights to contribution are NOT affected by the fault of a party (Rule D); fault is relocated to remedies and defences under the applicable law, not resolved in the adjustment. Separately, the Rule Paramount allows nothing unless reasonably made or incurred — a reasonableness gate, not a fault gate

Salvage: ALLOWED in GA under Rule VI(a) where the salvage operations were carried out to preserve the property from peril — subject to VI(b), (c) and (d). Where the parties are separately liable to salvors, VI(b) admits salvage only through five stated gateways. VI(d) excludes Article 14 special compensation and SCOPIC from GA. The blanket exclusion of salvage is the YAR 2004 position, not the 2016 one
Contribution: contributory values (ship, cargo, freight) share GA proportionally (Rules XVII-XX)

Interest on the allowances: it runs until three months after the adjustment is issued (Rule XXI(a)), and the rate is re-struck for each calendar year at the USD Prime Rate plus 2 per cent per annum, on the figure the Wall Street Journal carried for that year's opening banking day (Rule XXI(b), as technically amended by the CMI Assembly at Antwerp in October 2022). The LIBOR-linked basis originally adopted in May 2016 is SUPERSEDED: it is held as YAR-XXI-B-ORIGINAL and is deliberately NOT a governing object of this chain
